<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Email Notifikasi Campaign — CanQuest</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Source+Serif+4:opsz,wght@8..60,500;8..60,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --paper: #f1f2ef;
    --card: #ffffff;
    --ink: #14181d;
    --ink-soft: #5c6169;
    --line: #dfe1dc;
    --line-soft: #eaece7;
    --brand: #0e8f63;
    --brand-deep: #0a6d4b;
    --brand-soft: #e2f2e9;
    --warn: #a1560c;
    --warn-soft: #f7ecdf;
    --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
    --serif: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
  body {
    margin: 0;
    background: var(--paper);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Inter, sans-serif;
  }
  .wrap { max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 56px 22px 90px; }

  /* ── header ───────────────────────────── */
  .doc-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .doc-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .doc-tag { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ink-soft); text-transform: uppercase; }
  h1.doc-title { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.3; margin: 0 0 10px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  p.doc-lead { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0 0 34px; max-width: 54ch; }
  p.doc-lead b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

  /* ── lifecycle ticker (real sequence: announce → draw → result) ── */
  .ticker { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 46px; }
  .tick { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); white-space: nowrap; }
  .tick .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--line); flex: 0 0 auto; }
  .tick.on .dot { background: var(--brand); }
  .tick b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .tick-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 0 4px, transparent 4px 8px); margin: 0 12px; }

  /* ── section ──────────────────────────── */
  .email-section { margin-bottom: 58px; }
  .section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .section-state { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--brand); }
  .section-state.warn { color: var(--warn); }
  .section-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
  .section-sub { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 16px; max-width: 58ch; }

  .meta { border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .meta-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: 12.5px; }
  .meta-k { flex: 0 0 118px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 11px; padding-top: 1px; }
  .meta-v { color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.5; }
  .meta-v code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; background: var(--line-soft); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; color: var(--brand-deep); }

  /* ── mail client chrome ───────────────── */
  .client-frame { border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .client-top { background: var(--card); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .client-top .dot-row { display: flex; gap: 5px; margin-right: 6px; }
  .client-top .cdot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--line); }

  .inbox-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 13px 18px; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); }
  .inbox-avatar { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--serif); }
  .inbox-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .inbox-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
  .inbox-from { font-weight: 600; color: #20242e; }
  .inbox-time { color: #8a8f98; font-size: 11.5px; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--mono); }
  .inbox-subject { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #20242e; margin-top: 3px; }
  .inbox-snippet { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8a8f98; margin-top: 2px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .label-pill { display: inline-block; margin-left: 7px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--brand-deep); background: var(--brand-soft); border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 6px; vertical-align: 1px; }
  .label-pill.warn { color: var(--warn); background: var(--warn-soft); }

  .note { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink-soft); padding-left: 12px; border-left: 2px solid var(--line); }
  .note b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

  .divider { height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 54px 0; }
  h2.foot-h { font-family: var(--serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  dl.foot-list { margin: 0; }
  dl.foot-list div { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 9px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
  dl.foot-list dt { flex: 0 0 148px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-soft); padding-top: 1px; }
  dl.foot-list dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  dl.foot-list dd b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  dl.foot-list code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--brand-deep); background: var(--brand-soft); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <div class="doc-head">
    <span class="doc-mark"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CanQuest" style="height:16px;width:auto;display:block;"></span>
    <span class="doc-tag">Email spec · rev 3</span>
  </div>

  <h1 class="doc-title">Notifikasi campaign, tiga kondisi</h1>
  <p class="doc-lead">
    Dikirim otomatis lewat <b>Resend</b>, hanya ke user yang sudah punya wallet. Isi berbahasa Inggris,
    dirender pakai font sistem — bukan font custom, supaya tampil konsisten di Gmail/Outlook.
  </p>

  <div class="ticker">
    <div class="tick on"><span class="dot"></span><b>Campaign dibuat</b></div>
    <div class="tick-rule"></div>
    <div class="tick on"><span class="dot"></span>Draw dijalankan</div>
    <div class="tick-rule"></div>
    <div class="tick on"><span class="dot"></span>Hasil diumumkan</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ EMAIL 1 : CAMPAIGN BARU ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="email-section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-state">01 · Campaign live</span>
      <span class="section-title">CAMPAIGN_ANNOUNCEMENT</span>
    </div>
    <p class="section-sub">Terkirim saat admin membuat campaign baru, atau status berubah dari COMING_SOON ke ACTIVE. Satu tujuan: bikin orang klik masuk sebelum reward pool habis.</p>

    <div class="meta">
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Penerima</div><div class="meta-v">Semua user ber-wallet, ACTIVE, email terverifikasi, belum unsubscribe</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">From</div><div class="meta-v">CanQuest &lt;noreply@canquest.cc&gt;</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Subject</div><div class="meta-v">New campaign: Testnet Payment Challenge — 2,000 CC + 500 USDCx up for grabs</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="client-frame">
      <div class="client-top"><div class="dot-row"><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div></div>aria@gmail.com — Inbox</div>

      <div class="inbox-row">
        <div class="inbox-avatar">C</div>
        <div class="inbox-main">
          <div class="inbox-top"><span class="inbox-from">CanQuest <span class="label-pill">campaign</span></span><span class="inbox-time">09:12</span></div>
          <div class="inbox-subject">New campaign: Testnet Payment Challenge — 2,000 CC + 500 USDCx up for grabs</div>
          <div class="inbox-snippet">NovaPay is live on CanQuest. Complete the tasks, join the raffle — you already have everything you need.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ISI EMAIL 1 -->
      <div style="font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:#eceeeb;padding:30px 14px;">
        <div style="max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #e2e4e0;">

          <div style="padding:28px 30px 6px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px;">
              <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CanQuest" style="height:18px;width:auto;display:block;">
              <span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#0e8f63;text-transform:uppercase;">Campaign live</span>
            </div>

            <div style="font-size:12px;color:#8a8f98;margin-bottom:16px;">
              <span style="color:#14181d;font-weight:600;">NovaPay</span> · Partner campaign on Canton Network
            </div>

            <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;color:#14181d;font-weight:700;">Testnet Payment Challenge is live</h1>
            <p style="margin:0 0 20px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#5c6169;">
              Your wallet's already connected, so you can jump straight to the tasks below —
              finish them before the deadline to enter the reward raffle.
            </p>

            <!-- ledger-style stat block -->
            <div style="border:1px solid #e2e4e0;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 18px;margin-bottom:22px;background:#fafbfa;">
              <table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eceeeb;">
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12px;color:#8a8f98;">Reward pool</td>
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#14181d;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,'IBM Plex Mono',Menlo,monospace;">2,000 CC + 500 USDCx</td>
                </tr>
                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eceeeb;">
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12px;color:#8a8f98;">Winners</td>
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#14181d;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,'IBM Plex Mono',Menlo,monospace;">50 · raffle draw</td>
                </tr>
                <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eceeeb;">
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12px;color:#8a8f98;">Ends</td>
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#14181d;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,'IBM Plex Mono',Menlo,monospace;">Sep 5, 2026 · 23:59 UTC</td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12px;color:#8a8f98;">Time needed</td>
                  <td style="padding:11px 0;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:#14181d;text-align:right;font-family:ui-monospace,'IBM Plex Mono',Menlo,monospace;">3 tasks · ~10 min</td>
                </tr>
              </table>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:22px;">
              <a href="#" style="display:inline-block;padding:13px 30px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5EE89C 0%,#2DE0D6 100%);color:#04120b;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;">Join the campaign</a>
            </div>

            <p style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8f98;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding-top:14px;margin:0;">
              Tasks are verified automatically and rewards settle on-chain. Full rules on the campaign page.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div style="background:#f8f8f7;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding:16px 30px;text-align:center;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11px;color:#9a9fa6;line-height:1.6;">
              You're getting this because you have a CanQuest account.
              <a href="#" style="color:#5c6169;text-decoration:underline;">Manage email preferences</a>
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:10.5px;color:#b3b7bd;">CanQuest · Built on Canton Network</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ EMAIL 2 : MENANG ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="email-section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-state">02 · Draw complete</span>
      <span class="section-title">CAMPAIGN_WINNER</span>
    </div>
    <p class="section-sub">Terkirim begitu admin menjalankan Draw Winners — hanya ke wallet yang terpilih. Nada tenang, angka reward jadi fokus utama, bukan efek perayaan.</p>

    <div class="meta">
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Penerima</div><div class="meta-v">Wallet yang muncul di hasil WinnerDraw</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">From</div><div class="meta-v">CanQuest &lt;noreply@canquest.cc&gt;</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Subject</div><div class="meta-v">You won the Canton Ignition Raffle</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="client-frame">
      <div class="client-top"><div class="dot-row"><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div></div>aria@gmail.com — Inbox</div>

      <div class="inbox-row">
        <div class="inbox-avatar">C</div>
        <div class="inbox-main">
          <div class="inbox-top"><span class="inbox-from">CanQuest <span class="label-pill">raffle</span></span><span class="inbox-time">14:03</span></div>
          <div class="inbox-subject">You won the Canton Ignition Raffle</div>
          <div class="inbox-snippet">Your wallet was selected in the draw. Claim your reward before the window closes.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ISI EMAIL 2 -->
      <div style="font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:#eceeeb;padding:30px 14px;">
        <div style="max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #e2e4e0;">

          <div style="padding:28px 30px 6px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px;">
              <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CanQuest" style="height:18px;width:auto;display:block;">
              <span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#0e8f63;text-transform:uppercase;">Raffle · winner</span>
            </div>

            <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;color:#14181d;font-weight:700;">Your wallet was drawn, @aria</h1>
            <p style="margin:0 0 22px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#5c6169;">
              The draw for <b style="color:#14181d;">Canton Ignition Raffle</b> just closed, and you're one of the winners.
            </p>

            <!-- receipt-stub reward block -->
            <div style="border:1px dashed #c7cbc5;border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;">
              <div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#8a8f98;text-transform:uppercase;">Reward</div>
              <div style="font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:#14181d;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-top:6px;font-family:ui-monospace,'IBM Plex Mono',Menlo,monospace;">50 CC</div>
              <div style="border-top:1px dashed #c7cbc5;margin-top:14px;padding-top:10px;font-size:11.5px;color:#8a8f98;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;">
                <span>Settles on-chain</span>
                <span>Claim by Sep 12, 2026</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
              <a href="#" style="display:inline-block;padding:13px 30px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5EE89C 0%,#2DE0D6 100%);color:#04120b;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;">Claim your reward</a>
            </div>
            <p style="text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:#8a8f98;margin:0 0 20px;">
              Reward status also shows in your dApp dashboard.
            </p>

            <p style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8f98;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding-top:14px;margin:0;">
              If this campaign has a claim fee, it's shown before you confirm. CanQuest staff will never ask for your seed phrase.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div style="background:#f8f8f7;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding:16px 30px;text-align:center;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11px;color:#9a9fa6;line-height:1.6;">
              You're getting this because you have a CanQuest account.
              <a href="#" style="color:#5c6169;text-decoration:underline;">Manage email preferences</a>
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:10.5px;color:#b3b7bd;">CanQuest · Built on Canton Network</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="note">Untuk reward tipe kode/USDCx, angka dan label di blok reward menyesuaikan otomatis — <b>"1 Invite Code"</b>, <b>"25 USDCx"</b>, atau kombinasi — sesuai <code style="font-family:var(--mono);background:var(--line-soft);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;">rewardVariant</code> di WinnerDraw.</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════ EMAIL 3 : TIDAK TERPILIH ═══════════════ -->
  <div class="email-section">
    <div class="section-head">
      <span class="section-state warn">03 · Results final</span>
      <span class="section-title">CAMPAIGN_NOT_SELECTED</span>
    </div>
    <p class="section-sub">Terkirim saat draw ditandai final atau campaign berstatus ENDED, ke peserta yang ikut tapi tidak terpilih. Jujur soal hasilnya, tapi tetap mengarahkan ke langkah berikutnya.</p>

    <div class="meta">
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Penerima</div><div class="meta-v">Peserta dengan QuestCompletion, tanpa WinnerDraw di campaign ini</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">From</div><div class="meta-v">CanQuest &lt;noreply@canquest.cc&gt;</div></div>
      <div class="meta-row"><div class="meta-k">Subject</div><div class="meta-v">Raffle results: Canton Ignition Raffle</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="client-frame">
      <div class="client-top"><div class="dot-row"><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div><div class="cdot"></div></div>aria@gmail.com — Inbox</div>

      <div class="inbox-row">
        <div class="inbox-avatar">C</div>
        <div class="inbox-main">
          <div class="inbox-top"><span class="inbox-from">CanQuest <span class="label-pill warn">raffle</span></span><span class="inbox-time">14:03</span></div>
          <div class="inbox-subject">Raffle results: Canton Ignition Raffle</div>
          <div class="inbox-snippet">The draw is complete. You weren't selected this time — a new campaign is launching soon.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ISI EMAIL 3 -->
      <div style="font-family:-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Inter,Arial,sans-serif;background:#eceeeb;padding:30px 14px;">
        <div style="max-width:520px;margin:0 auto;background:#ffffff;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #e2e4e0;">

          <div style="padding:28px 30px 6px;">
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px;">
              <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="CanQuest" style="height:18px;width:auto;display:block;">
              <span style="font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#8a8f98;text-transform:uppercase;">Raffle · results</span>
            </div>

            <h1 style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;color:#14181d;font-weight:700;">Not your draw this time</h1>
            <p style="margin:0 0 18px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:#5c6169;">
              Thanks for completing <b style="color:#14181d;">Canton Ignition Raffle</b>. The winners have been drawn, and
              your wallet wasn't selected in this round.
            </p>

            <div style="border-left:2px solid #e2e4e0;padding:2px 0 2px 14px;margin-bottom:22px;">
              <p style="margin:0;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#5c6169;">
                Points from the tasks you have completed will remain saved in your account—and new campaigns
                have arrived on CanQuest, some offering instant rewards on a first-come, first-served basis.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
              <a href="#" style="display:inline-block;padding:13px 30px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#5EE89C 0%,#2DE0D6 100%);color:#04120b;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;">Explore live campaigns</a>
            </div>
            <p style="text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:#8a8f98;margin:0 0 20px;">
              4 campaigns open right now
            </p>

            <p style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#8a8f98;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding-top:14px;margin:0;">
              Raffle draws are random and final. You can turn off campaign emails anytime from the link below.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div style="background:#f8f8f7;border-top:1px solid #eceeeb;padding:16px 30px;text-align:center;">
            <p style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11px;color:#9a9fa6;line-height:1.6;">
              You're getting this because you have a CanQuest account.
              <a href="#" style="color:#5c6169;text-decoration:underline;">Manage email preferences</a>
            </p>
            <p style="margin:0;font-size:10.5px;color:#b3b7bd;">CanQuest · Built on Canton Network</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="note">Subject sengaja tidak bilang "you lost" — cukup netral di inbox. Isinya sendiri tetap jujur: tidak terpilih, plus arahan ke campaign lain.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="divider"></div>

  <h2 class="foot-h">Catatan implementasi</h2>
  <dl class="foot-list">
    <div><dt>Filter penerima</dt><dd>Hanya user dengan <code>cantonPartyId</code> terisi dan bukan placeholder <code>canquest:</code> — pakai helper <code>hasRealWallet</code> yang sudah ada.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Anti-duplikat</dt><dd>Tabel <code>EmailNotificationLog</code> dengan unique <code>[userId, questId, type]</code>, jadi draw bertahap tetap aman.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Unsubscribe</dt><dd>Footer "Manage email preferences" + field <code>emailNotificationsEnabled</code> di User, dihormati semua query penerima.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Pengiriman</dt><dd>Batch Resend (maks 100/call) lewat Bull/Redis yang sudah berjalan. Gagal → retry otomatis 3x, status SENT/FAILED tercatat.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Kill-switch</dt><dd>Env <code>EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED</code> untuk mematikan semua email campaign tanpa deploy ulang.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Panjang konten</dt><dd>Gmail memotong email panjang dengan "…view entire message" — makanya tiap template dijaga ringkas, ±satu layar.</dd></div>
  </dl>

</div>
</body>
</html>
